name: vibelearner-ide-assistant
description: Vibe coding that teaches: an AI pair-programmer that sees your whole project, proposes reviewable edits, explains every change, and checks your understanding.

commands.title: VibeLearner: Quiz Me on My Program

vibelearner.apiProvider.description: Which backend to use. Defaults to local Ollama.

vibelearner.endpoint.description: HTTP endpoint. For Ollama use: http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/chat

vibelearner.gemini.apiKey.description: Google AI Studio / Gemini API key.

vibelearner.eduaiApiKey.description: EduAI backend API key used for course-aware RAG.

vibelearner.courseCode.description: Default course code to send to EduAI for contextual RAG.

vibelearner.pythonPath.description: Python executable used to run program tests (default: 'python' on Windows, 'python3' elsewhere).

vibelearner.study.condition.description: Study condition for this participant. 'vibelearner' = structured workflow; 'direct' = plain AI code generation (control). Set before the participant begins.

vibelearner.study.language.description: Programming language for all study tasks.

vibelearner.study.taskIds.description: Ordered task ids used when study.mode is 'tasks' (see src/study/tasks.ts).

vibelearner.study.maxClarifications.description: Maximum clarification rounds before code is generated anyway. Tune in the pilot.

vibelearner.study.comprehensionQuestions.description: Predict-then-run questions asked after the multiple-choice quiz in the check (VibeLearner condition). 0 = quiz only.

vibelearner.study.mode.description: 'open' = the student builds any program they like (AI checks the request is detailed enough, then teaches while it builds). 'tasks' = fixed instructor-designed tasks with unit tests (for the controlled study).

vibelearner.study.quizQuestions.description: Multiple-choice conceptual quiz questions that open the check (VibeLearner condition). 0 skips the quiz.

vibelearner.workflow.description: 'vibe' = project mode (AI pair-programmer that teaches while you build). 'study' = the older fixed-task study workflow. Reopen the panel after changing.

enumDescriptions: Plain vibe-coding assistant (comparison/control): no prompt coaching, planning, walkthroughs or checks.
All learning tools available as buttons (plan, walkthrough, predict & run, check, your turn); nothing starts automatically.
The learning loop runs automatically around every change: walkthrough before accepting, then predict & run, check, and a your-turn challenge. Every step can be skipped.
vibelearner.learning.level.description: How much learning support VibeLearner adds on top of vibe coding.

vibelearner.learning.clarify.description: Ask clarifying questions (or explain conceptually) when a build request is too vague. Bounded by learning.maxClarifications.

vibelearner.learning.maxClarifications.description: Max clarifying rounds before the assistant builds anyway with stated assumptions.

vibelearner.learning.questionsPerChange.description: Multiple-choice questions in the Check step for one change.

vibelearner.learning.projectQuizQuestion.description: Questions in 'Quiz me on my program'.

vibelearner.context.maxChars.description: Character budget for project files sent to the model each turn. Larger = more of the program visible, slower on local models.
